{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: Continuous Integration

on:
  push:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'sources/**'
      - '*.md'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'sources/**'
      - '*.md'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  linux:
    name: Linux
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04

    steps:
      - name: Clone Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Remove System .NET
        run: sudo apt-get remove -y dotnet*

      - name: Install .NET 10
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Cache NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.nuget/packages
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-v1-${{ hashFiles('**/*.csproj', '**/*.slnx', '**/packages.lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-v1-

      - name: Check Code
        run: |
          make check

      - name: Retrieve Changed Files
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        id: changes
        run: |
          git fetch origin main --depth=1
          git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM origin/main ${{ github.sha }} > changed_files.txt
          grep -E 'mods/hv/bits/.*\.png' changed_files.txt > sprites_changed_files.txt || true
          echo "sprites=$(cat sprites_changed_files.txt | tr '\n' ' ')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check Sprites
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
            ALL_CHANGED_SPRITES: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.sprites }}
        run: |
          make check-sprites SPRITE_FILES="${ALL_CHANGED_SPRITES}"
          sudo apt-get install pngcheck
          make check-pngs

      - name: Check Sounds
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install oggz-tools
          make check-ogg

      - name: Check Mod
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install lua5.1
          make check-scripts -j2
          make TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=true test

  windows:
    name: Windows
    runs-on: windows-2022

    steps:
      - name: Clone Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install .NET 10
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Cache NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.nuget/packages
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-v1-${{ hashFiles('**/*.csproj', '**/*.slnx', '**/packages.lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-v1-

      - name: Check Code
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          .\make.ps1 check

      - name: Check Mods
        run: |
          choco install lua --version 5.1.5.52 --no-progress
          $ENV:Path = $ENV:Path + ";C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Lua\\5.1\\"
          .\make.ps1 check-scripts
          .\make.ps1 test", "rationale": "The workflow builds .NET solutions on every run but has no dependency cache, so NuGet packages are re-fetched/restored on each job. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache) is evidence-supported with a reported vm_time_reduction_percent (free: 6, paid: 3.4) and its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs, no equivalent cache already exists, and cache inputs can include lockfile/solution files plus the runner OS. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.nuget/packages, keyed on hashFiles of *.csproj/*.slnx/packages.lock.json with OS-scoped restore keys, preserves every existing build and test step unchanged, adds no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions, and only shortens warm runs while cold runs fall back to a normal restore.", "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]}
